sam/turntable.model: A 1960s record player: a walnut wood plinth, a black vinyl record with a blue label on the platter, a chrome tonearm resting on the record, two silver knobs at the front

sam/porch.model: The front porch of a small Texas house at night: a wooden deck, white posts and railing, a tin roof, a warm porch lamp, a red electric guitar leaning on a small black amplifier, a rocking chair

test-dev/wall.model: A tall, sharp sandstone rock spire like the Naked Edge in Eldorado Canyon, Colorado: red and orange layered rock with lichen, a knife-edge arete, a climbing rope running up its face

test-dev/van.model: A white high-roof camper van with an orange stripe along its side, a black roof rack, big off-road tyres, a ladder on the back doors, ready for a weekend of climbing

test-ines/oven.model: A traditional Portuguese wood-fired bread oven: a whitewashed clay dome on a low stone base, an arched brick opening with a fire glowing inside, a short chimney, three round loaves cooling on the ledge

test-ines/tram.model: A vintage Lisbon tram, Tram 28: a short wooden tram car painted yellow below and cream above, rounded roof, a row of windows down each side, a trolley pole on the roof, the number 28 on the front

test-ines/pao.model: A Portuguese Pão de Deus sweet bun: a round, golden-brown glossy brioche bun with a crackly top of toasted shredded coconut, dusted with icing sugar
